measurementRules.rule: Q is the calibrated net mass of unique newly first-released complete articles. Include accepted closing FG once; exclude detachable packaging, earlier released FG, raw material and WIP. Record tare, moisture conditioning, length, gauge, complete slider/stops and release IDs. Reinspection or redispatch is not new release.

Calibrated weighing of the complete configured zipper establishes actual net article mass for each matched size/length/slider/finish/moisture stratum. Counts or lengths may be converted only by that measured configuration-specific relationship and sampling uncertainty; never guess kg per zipper, tooth density, resin density or service life. An item is the same physical count as Item(s) at factor 1 if a native count property is actually used; that does not supply a kg conversion.

Preserve original unit and whether the observation is an amount, integrated volume or rate. Apply exact unit factors once before stock attribution: electricity kWh to MJ uses 3.6. Integrate only an actual rate over its observed time. Convert liquid/gas volume to mass using independently established density at that substance composition, temperature and pressure, or preserve verified native volume; integrated V is not multiplied by time again. Do not infer density from a secondary flow-property coefficient or substitute water density for another material.

One whole supplied formulation or slider is one purchase; assays and carrier water/embedded components are subledgers. Onsite preparation uses each actual purchased feed with real mixing utilities and losses. Never count a whole wet article plus its included dry constituents/water as simultaneous exchanges.

Collection stores undivided raw records. Stock conversion, carried-vector transfer and justified allocation produce one A_i,c in the original exchange unit. The sole section 8 calculation divides by Q_c once; cards and aggregation descriptors only refer to its reporting basis. Q_c is first-release mass, including closing accepted FG, and is not gross volume V, a stock movement, observation H, sales value or a second stage denominator. If Q_c is zero preserve loads and withhold a unit result.

calculationRules.rule: For each raw event convert its original amount unit once; integrate only true rates. Derive substance mass from integrated V and independent state-specific density only where needed; electricity MJ = original kWh * 3.6. Preserve originals and identify measured already-net stock issues. This step contains no Q or H division.

Apply the complete normative physical-stock and inherited-vector balances in section 5 together with section 8 protocols plus the section 7 exchange-specific allocation hierarchy. For each row and originating cohort create A_i,c in that exchange original/reference numerator unit, or A_i,c(H) for actual services. Historical released FG never creates new production. Preserve full failed/zero-output loads and eliminate only actual paired internal transfers on consolidation. This step contains no normalization division. U_new is actual addition BEFORE stockcorrection; A=Bopen+Unew−Bclose−Tother only truly unused/unassigned raw/WIPvectors. AcceptedFG/performedservice not unused. Ownhistory versus aggregate/decomposedproviders nonoverlap, fullphysicalstocks independent.

measurementRules.rule: Q 为唯一新增首次放行完整制品的校准净质量，一次包含期末已合格 FG，排除可分离包装、先前放行 FG 及原料和 WIP。记录皮重及调湿、长度规格、完整拉头止挡与放行标识，重验或再发运不构成新增放行。
按匹配规格长度拉头整理及含水分层，校准称量完整配置拉链，建立真实净条质量。条数或长度仅按该实测配置关系及抽样不确定性换算，不猜每条 kg 或齿密度、树脂密度及寿命。若实际采用原生计数属性，item 与 Item(s) 是因子 1 的相同物理计数，但不提供 kg 换算。
保留原始单位以及数量、已积分体积或速率的观测类型；库存归属前准确换算一次，电力 kWh 至 MJ 用 3.6。仅真实速率按观察时间积分。液气体积转质量须用该物质组成及温压下独立确定的密度，或保留已核实原生体积；已积分 V 不再乘时间。不从次级流属性系数推密度，也不用水密度替代其他材料。
一份完整供货制剂或拉头只采购一次，检验及载水或内含组件是子账。厂内配制须列每种实际外购原料与真实混合公用工程和损失，不同时计入整份湿件及其内含干组分和水。
采集保存未除的原始记录。库存换算及继承向量转移和有依据分配产生原交换单位的一份 A_i,c。第 8 节唯一归一化计算除以 Q_c 一次，卡片及汇总描述只指该报告基准。Q_c 为包含期末已合格 FG 的首次放行质量，不是毛体积 V 或库存移动、观察期 H、销售额及第二阶段分母。Q_c 为零时保留负荷并不输出单位结果。

calculationRules.rule: 各原始事件单位换算一次，仅对真实速率积分。确需时以已积分 V 和独立状态专属密度得物质质量；电力 MJ = 原始 kWh * 3.6。保留原件，识别已实测净额的库存领用；此步骤不除以 Q 或 H。

应用第 5 节规范规则与第 8 节协议共同规定的独立实体库存及继承向量平衡和第 7 节逐交换分配层级，为各行及原批次形成该交换分子单位的 A_i,c，实际服务形成 A_i,c(H)。历史已放行 FG 不新增产量，保留全部失败及零产出负荷，仅在合并时消除真实成对内部转移。本步骤不含归一化相除。 U_new为库存修正前实际新增，A=Bopen+Unew−Bclose−Tother仅真实未用未归属原料WIP向量，已验收FG已执行服务非未用结存。自身史与聚合拆解供方不重叠，全实物库存独立。
x_i,c=A_i,c除各原正Q0,c一次用于有据相容模型需求；实物V/Qt除正Q_analysis仅标观察。匹配内部产品转移按实际追溯物质量除原Q0,c，成对一次抵消不采购。真实全接收处理量一次，嵌套谱系及不重叠服务向量不缩实物或每队列重复全Qt。实际Q=0未知保留原账无单位结果，H不作除数。
